in_hebrew.name: מָעֲדִיָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The lady, or woman, who is bitter, perhaps because of past sorrows or trials.

in_greek.name: Μαυδία
in_greek.long_meaning: A name of Hebrew origin, adopted in Greek, meaning 'bitter one'. It may denote a woman who is bitter due to past experiences or one who mourns bitterly.

in_latin.name: Maudia
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latinized form of the Hebrew or Greek name 'Maudie', meaning 'bitter one'.
